clusters.dom:
Chelsey
There are other websites and apps for adhd, but they don’t cover nearly the range of topics AND try to teach you some ways to deal with them now that you know. The zoom rooms where everyone shares what they’re working on and focuses on them together is also incredible, I can’t understate how helpful they have been. Even once I absorb and learn all I can from the lessons and such, I’ll still be keeping my subscription to be able to join these rooms.

Feb 22, 2023

Chelsey
There are other websites and apps for adhd, but they don’t cover nearly the range of topics AND try to teach you some ways to deal with them now that you know. The zoom rooms where everyone shares what they’re working on and focuses on them together is also incredible, I can’t understate how helpful they have been. Even once I absorb and learn all I can from the lessons and such, I’ll still be keeping my subscription to be able to join these rooms.

Feb 22, 2023
